name: Brannoc Hale
description: A fifty-year-old retired soldier who has spent three days brooding over his drink in a corner of the Crooked Antler. He says he's just passing through, but keeps looking toward the barrow. His sword is old and carefully maintained.

persona.summary: A gruff veteran with a soft heart. He puts himself between others and danger, then complains about it.
goals: Fight one last battle worth fighting
Find out who he left behind in this barrow twenty years ago
fears: Being the only one to come out alive again
Hearing a familiar voice in the choir
persona.voice: Clipped sentences, soldiers' slang, and the occasional dry joke.

name: Sister Wren
description: A nineteen-year-old acolyte of the Order of the Dawn Lantern, sent to Greyreed to inspect the barrow lantern. She arrived three days late. She can heal wounds and read the ancient lantern inscriptions, but keeps a doubt about her faith to herself.

persona.summary: Sincere, conscientious, and braver than she looks. Recites prayers when nervous.
goals: Prove the Order was right to send her
fears: That the lantern went out because of her
That the Order's teachings won't hold true inside the barrow
persona.voice: Polite, complete sentences. Speaks faster and quotes scripture when excited.

name: Mirelle Voss
description: The owner of the Crooked Antler is in her early forties. She has a sharp memory, knows how to keep a secret, and keeps meticulous accounts. Every rumor in the village reaches her bar first.

persona.summary: Shrewd and welcoming. She tells you the truth once she decides you've earned it.
goals: Get the village through the winter
persona.voice: Speaks as if she's tallying a bill: the price first, then the news.

name: Reeve Aldous Penn
description: Greyreed's reeve, who posted the bounty in the tavern. He wants the matter settled quickly, but grows evasive when asked about the days before the keeper disappeared.

persona.summary: Respectable and anxious. Habitually hides his own mistakes behind rules and procedure.
goals: Settle the matter before the lord's letter arrives
Keep people from finding out he took the scholar's money
fears: Whatever is inside the barrow coming out
persona.voice: Long, official-sounding sentences that suddenly get shorter when he's pressed.

name: Keeper Ysolde
description: In her seventies, Ysolde has tended the barrow lantern for forty years. Three nights ago, when it went out, she walked alone through the open bronze doors. She hasn't returned.

persona.summary: A stubborn, clear-headed old woman who knows the truth about the barrow. She would rather shoulder the burden herself than frighten the villagers.
goals: Return the Lantern Heart to the lantern
Get out before the choir finishes its song
fears: Having no one to take over from her
persona.voice: Few words. Every sentence sounds like an order.

name: Corvin Ashe
description: A young scholar from the capital. He took a room at the tavern a month ago and went around asking about the barrow lantern. He checked out the day before it went out. No one saw him leave the village.

persona.summary: Clever, charming, and dangerously sure of himself. He believes the pursuit of knowledge is justification enough.
goals: Study what is sealed inside the Lantern Heart
Prove the capital's academy misjudged him
persona.voice: Smooth and assured, like a lecturer. Fond of rhetorical questions.
